labs.research_summary: Harvard Kennedy School hub for research, teaching and training on human rights, with programs on technology, LGBTQI+ rights and U.S. foreign policy.
labs.join_notes: Opportunities page describes student opportunities (funding, events, research and applied learning) and fellowship opportunities, and gives carr_center@hks.harvard.edu as the contact.
labs.notes: Maggie Gates is Executive Director (profile https://www.hks.harvard.edu/about/maggie-gates). People page lists 9 staff with emails, a faculty committee, faculty associates and several fellow cohorts (some people appear in two). Member count left null because fellow cohorts overlap. Staff: program assistant, communications staff, finance manager, fellowships coordinator, events coordinator and 3 LGBTQI+ program staff.
Listed on Carr-Ryan's people page; not read further. Program staff there also include a program manager and a changemakers program manager.

notes: A Technology and Human Rights Program is also mentioned but no lead was shown, so no entry.
